column1: # glyphs components: kind  name  key  description  flags (see lib/components.sh)
# Enter prints the glyph (the zsh widget inserts it); in blocks it opens the block.
mode    nerd     -       Nerd Font glyphs by name (nf-set-name), with their code points             default
mode    unicode  -       named Unicode characters with their block (--block NAME: one block's)     -
mode    blocks   -       the Unicode blocks: enter or ctrl-o opens one                             -
mode    emoji    -       emoji by name, with their group and subgroup                               -
action  copy     ctrl-y  copy the glyphs                                                            silent,builtin
action  code     alt-c   copy the code points (U+EB99)                                              silent,notify
action  name     alt-n   copy the names (nerd: nf-cod-account)                                      silent,notify
action  escape   alt-e   copy them as escapes (, \U0001F600 above FFFF)                       silent,notify
action  update   alt-U   nerd: download the latest Nerd Font glyph names                            foreground,reload
